task: Confirm project authority, commercial scope, six-week outcome, and excluded work
evidence_link: MSP and customer decision owners approve the same bounded outcome

task: Name the MSP project owner, customer decision owner, technical leads, and escalation path
evidence_link: Every critical decision and escalation has one named owner

task: Request named least-privilege access to Microsoft cloud, RMM, security, backup, service desk, documentation, and network systems
evidence_link: Required portals have a named request, approver, due date, MFA method, and status

task: Select one representative pilot customer and record sites, users, endpoints, servers, critical services, and tolerated downtime
evidence_link: Pilot scope is representative, noncritical enough to control, and approved by the decision owner

task: Define baseline evidence and exit measures for inventory coverage, alert routing, patching, remote support, backup, tickets, documentation, and NOC readiness
evidence_link: Every promised outcome has a measurable before state, target, evidence source, and acceptance owner

task: Shadow the current onboarding process from request through handoff
evidence_link: Map distinguishes actual work from intended policy and records undocumented handoffs

task: Reconcile customer records against observed tenants, sites, devices, services, vendors, contracts, licenses, and open work
evidence_link: Each mismatch has an owner, impact, and disposition

task: Test every required administrative and vendor escalation path without storing secrets in the project register
evidence_link: Named access works with MFA and least privilege; vault references replace copied credentials

task: Draft the onboarding SOP as the workflow is observed, marking unknowns and decisions instead of inventing ideal-state steps
evidence_link: Each step names an actor, input, action, evidence, exception path, and handoff

task: Create an exception and decision log for missing access, unsupported systems, unclear ownership, security findings, and scope changes
evidence_link: Every open item has severity, owner, decision date, workaround, and escalation trigger

task: Map customer, site, group, policy, naming, maintenance-window, and alert-routing structure before agent deployment
evidence_link: Mappings are reviewed against tenant isolation and customer ownership

task: Validate endpoint identity, inventory, heartbeat, audit history, agent removal, and reinstall behavior on a controlled nonproduction endpoint
evidence_link: One device completes the full install-to-removal lifecycle with attributable evidence

task: Test alert creation, suppression, maintenance behavior, routing, ticket creation, ownership, acknowledgement, and escalation
evidence_link: A test alert reaches the correct queue and owner without duplicate or orphaned work

task: Validate patch ring, approval, reboot, deferral, exception, failure, and post-action evidence
evidence_link: The pilot shows both successful and exception outcomes with rollback or recovery ownership

task: Verify backup ownership, recent job evidence, approved restore test, remote-support controls, and rollback paths
evidence_link: Recovery evidence meets the customer's acceptance criteria and all privileged actions are attributable

task: Run a preflight review and obtain go or no-go approval for the pilot customer
evidence_link: No unresolved critical dependency lacks an explicit risk decision

task: Onboard the approved pilot customer in controlled waves with checkpoints and stop conditions
evidence_link: Each wave satisfies identity, policy, monitoring, patch, security, backup, and ticket checks before expansion

task: Record failed installs, duplicates, stale assets, conflicting tools, blocked ports, policy collisions, and unsupported endpoints
evidence_link: Every exception has evidence, operational impact, owner, workaround, and retest date

task: Issue planned-change, progress, outage, risk, and acceptance communications through the agreed channels
evidence_link: Stakeholders receive the right notice at the agreed cadence and know the escalation path

task: Revise the SOP from pilot evidence and separate standard flow, exception flow, and rollback flow
evidence_link: A technician unfamiliar with the pilot can follow the workflow without relying on unwritten context

task: Reconcile pilot scope against managed inventory, monitoring, patching, security, backup, service desk, and documentation coverage
evidence_link: Every in-scope asset or service is managed, accepted as an exception, or explicitly excluded

task: Review tenant placement, policy inheritance, alert noise, ticket duplication, failed automation, privileged access, and audit completeness
evidence_link: No high-risk configuration or unexplained evidence gap remains without an owner

task: Prove agent removal, access revocation, automation disablement, documentation retention, and rollback for a controlled endpoint
evidence_link: The endpoint returns to the approved prior state and residual access is reconciled

task: Publish approved network, identity, vendor, licensing, recovery, operating, and escalation documentation with owners and review dates
evidence_link: Documents are findable, access-controlled, current, and assigned to maintainers

task: Build role-based NOC exercises from real pilot alerts, tickets, exceptions, and escalation decisions
evidence_link: Exercises test detection, evidence gathering, safe action, escalation, and handoff rather than slide completion

task: Run NOC tabletop and hands-on exercises without the project lead driving the workflow
evidence_link: NOC staff independently complete agreed scenarios and document unresolved gaps

task: Review evidence with MSP and customer owners for inventory, access, monitoring, patching, security, backup, service desk, and documentation
evidence_link: Each control is accepted, rejected, or converted into a named exception with a due date

task: Transfer SOP ownership, dashboards, queues, reports, documentation, vendor contacts, and recurring review obligations
evidence_link: Receiving owners acknowledge every recurring task and evidence source

task: Publish the residual-risk, decision, exception, and follow-up register
evidence_link: No open risk or scope gap is hidden inside narrative notes or assumed ownership

task: Close the project only after acceptance, NOC readiness, rollback evidence, and scheduled follow-up are recorded
evidence_link: Decision owners sign off on achieved outcomes, exclusions, residual risks, and the next review date
